topic: Chapter introduction: Light – Reflection and Refraction
title: Light: Chapter Introduction
summary: We see things because light bounces off them into our eyes. At a surface light has 2 options: bounce back (reflection) or go in and bend (refraction).

notes.title: 00 – Light – Reflection and Refraction: Chapter Introduction

keyPoints: We see non-luminous objects by the light they **reflect** into our eyes.
**Reflection**: light returns into the same medium (mirrors).
**Refraction**: light bends on entering another medium because its speed changes (lenses).
Part 1: mirrors + reflection; Part 2: refraction + lenses. Your eye has a lens too.

quiz.q: Why can we not see objects in a completely dark room?
options: No light is reflected from them into our eyes
quiz.explain: We see objects by the light they reflect into our eyes.

quiz.q: A pencil in water looks broken because of:
quiz.explain: Light bends as it passes from water into air.
A mirror reflects light back into the same medium.

quiz.q: Light slows down on entering water obliquely. Its path:
quiz.explain: A change of speed at an oblique boundary bends the ray (refraction).
